Lina Park: Quick note—staging alert shows a small spike in "at-risk" tags after yesterday's playbook tweak.
Devon Shaw: Which tweak? I adjusted the onboarding playbook to stop auto-marking 'profile_complete' as full_engaged.
Lina Park: That likely explains it. A handful of accounts lost a +6 signal.
Devon Shaw: Preference: targeted backfill for accounts created in last 30 days where profile_complete + any product_event exists within 7d. No global revert.
CS-Playbook-Bot: Created backfill job id bf-2165-staging and queued with throttle 10/s.
Lina Park: Can we also add a short-lived mapping: profile_complete_cohort -> +2 if co-occurs, A/B 5%?
Devon Shaw: Yup will open PR for scoring patch and include a CI sim to measure net change.
Lina Park: Acceptance: <1% increase in at-risk per cohort. Attach CSM note for modified accounts.
CS-Playbook-Bot: Staging run completed: scanned 142 accounts, emitted 120 triggers, 22 skipped.
Devon Shaw: Staging health delta: green +18, yellow -14, red -4. Looks good. Scheduling prod backfill for 22:00 PT.
Lina Park: Thanks—please post the prod run summary here when done.
CS-Playbook-Bot: Prod run completed: processed 140 accounts, emitted 117 triggers, 23 skipped. Job id bf-2165-prod.
